Different Spokes Sunday Ride

Los Angeles, CA · Road

Different Spokes Sunday Ride is a road group ride in Los Angeles, CA. It rolls every Sunday at 8:00 am. About 28–75 miles, easy to demanding; no-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy to demanding; no-drop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Different Spokes Sunday Ride group ride

Southern California's LGBTQ+ cycling club, riding since 1983. Sunday rides across the LA area from easy to hard, with a monthly easier ride. Everyone is welcome; helmets required. Check the club calendar for this week's start.
